design.summary: Gentle forest keeper in moss-green robes with an antler crown, a leaf cloak and a gnarled wooden staff.
design.silhouette: Wide antler crown above a round hooded head, scalloped leaf cloak making a bell shape, tall staff reaching just above the antlers in the right hand.

headgear.description: A round moss-green hood topped with a crown of pale branching antlers and a few small leaves woven between the tines.

armour.description: Moss-green tunic with a bark-brown chest strap and a small acorn charm.
Braided vine belt with two hanging herb pouches.
Wrapped bark-brown boots with moss cuffs.

design.cloth: A scalloped cloak made of overlapping green leaves hangs from the shoulders to the knees, with a darker green inner lining.
design.weapon_summary: A gnarled wooden staff reaching only a little above the antler crown, with a curled top holding a glowing pale green seed-bulb; carried in the right hand.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: gnarled staff
weapon.description: A gnarled wooden staff reaching only a little above the antler crown, with a curled top holding a glowing pale green seed-bulb; carried in the right hand.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: antler crown from behind, hood back, the scalloped leaf cloak covering the whole back, staff shaft at the right side.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the leaf cloak.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the leaf cloak sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the leaf cloak settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the leaf cloak.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the leaf cloak flares.
Wind-up: staff pulled back over the right shoulder with both hands, weight on the back foot.
Staff swings forward in a wide horizontal arc at waist height, body turning.
Strike: staff fully extended ahead at the far reach, tip leading, front knee bent.
Follow-through: staff swept past the body to the left, torso twisted, leaf cloak flaring.
Recover: staff returning upright to the right side, feet together, cloak settling.
Gather: staff lifted straight up in the right hand, left palm open, head bowed, leaves lifting.
Staff raised higher, seed-bulb glowing, antler crown tilted back, arms opening.
Arms spread wide, staff overhead, cloak flared like wings, knees bent.
Thrust: staff pointed forward at shoulder height at full reach, left hand flung open beside it.
Recover: staff lowering to the right side, leaf cloak fluttering down.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, the staff planted at the right side, left hand relaxed loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
